question.question: What did Calvin do recently at his Japanese house?

evidence_items.text:
- Will be in Japan for a few months, then off to Boston afterward [S1T15].
- Plans to visit the park with the lake that Dave recommended, since he has never been there [S1T17].
- On 2023-05-03, said embracing nature has been really calming for him, and that he's been loving getting to know Japanese culture [S5T10].
- As of 2023-06-21, has a small town in Japan on his to-do list to visit after his tour with Frank Ocean ends — he has never been there. Shared a photo of a small-town view with a mountain in the background, saying the view of the mountains is "unbelievably stunning"; can't wait to see it in person [S9T11][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].
- As of 2023-07-07, still living in Japan — his home is a Japanese mansion with an epic cityscape (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T6].
- As of 2023-07-07, looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture — "Japan is indeed amazing" [S10T10].
- As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (a continuation of his plan to collaborate with musicians in the area, see above) — "really excited to hear how it turns out"; promised Dave he'll share some clips when everything's ready; says collaborating with various artists is "always exciting, it's a chance to create something unique" [S10T12][S10T14].
- On 2023-09-22, said his trip to Japan was incredible — "the culture, the people, everything was so cool" — and "I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it." [S20T4].

- Excited to learn about Japanese culture and to "expand" [S1T5].
- Had never been to Japan before; fascinated by its traditions and eager to experience the culture [S1T7].
- Planning to go to Japan; Dave asked when he is leaving, but no departure date was given as of 2023-03-23 [S1T8].

- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].
- On 2023-07-07, caught up with Dave: Dave asked how the car was doing after the crash, and Calvin said it's all good now — fixed and going strong — sharing a photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)). Dave said he's been hanging out with friends at parks; Calvin shared photos of his mansion's backyard (a boat docked in a canal at sunset) and the mansion front, and Dave marveled at the views from the Japanese mansion (details in ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T1][S10T2][S10T3][S10T5][S10T6][S10T7][S10T8].
- The 2023-07-07 conversation continued: Calvin is looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture; when Dave said he has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" and is "hooked on" Japanese music, Calvin said Japan "definitely has it all" — vibes, food, tech, and an amazing culture, "like stepping into another world" — and told him he's working on music collaborations with Japanese artists; Dave can't wait for the tunes, and Calvin promised to share clips and "can't wait to show you" the results. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave, "Appreciate all the help", and saying "Great catching up, gotta get back to work now. Take care!" (Dave's Japan travel interest is in /memories/dave.md > ## Japan) [S10T9][S10T10][S10T11][S10T12][S10T13][S10T14][S10T15][S10T16]. Dave's final sign-off: "Hey Cal, take care and don't overwork yourself! Talk to you soon. Stay safe!" [S10T17].
- On 2023-08-03, reconnected with Dave ("long time no see!"): told him the recent Ferrari service was so stressful and that he's attached to the car, and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him and shared his fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T3].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing), which Calvin found cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best — "Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and that it's "like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of the car in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T4][S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-07-21, told Dave he is working on a project to transform his Japanese mansion into a recording studio — it has been his dream to have a space for creating music with other artists, and the studio is "my sanctuary that reminds [him] why [he] loves music" (home is the mansion from ## New home (2023-03-23); earlier studio photos are under ## Music); shared a photo of the progress so far (a room with a ladder in it) [S11T4].
- Has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone — adding electronic elements to his songs gives them "a fresh vibe"; he calls it "an exciting process of self-discovery and growth" [S11T6].
- Finds switching between styles challenging — "it's a matter of finding the right balance between sticking to [his] sound and trying new stuff"; "it can be intimidating, but that's what makes it so exciting and keeps [him] motivated to keep going!" [S11T8].

- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it.") [S27T10][S27T11][S27T12].
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what it was like when everyone was cheering him on: "It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." [S28T4][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, said creating something that people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like the party "really motivate me to keep growing!" (complements his earlier "passion and purpose" remark of 2023-10-25, see above) [S28T7].
